clue.text: Using cycle to ferry son is not going to work

indicators.note: to ferry is to carry, so the cycle phrase carries the son letter within it

parts.note: riding a tricycle is being on a trike

explanation.surface: Someone cycles their son to school, while a striking worker stays at home.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Using cycle' is read as riding a tricycle; 'ferry' means carry, so the son sits within the phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Workers who have downed tools in a dispute are refusing to work, an idiom for industrial action.

clue.text: Play about king constructing a city

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the play word goes round the king letter

parts.note: to play is to toy
R is short for rex, Latin for king

explanation.surface: A drama about a monarch who built a city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Play' looks like a stage drama but is the verb toy.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient city besieged by the Greeks in Homer's Iliad.

clue.text: Mechanical component of weapon unfinished on centre of bench

indicators.note: unfinished means the weapon word loses its last letter

parts.note: a pistol is a handgun

indicators.note: centre of picks the middle letter of the word bench

explanation.surface: A gun part left unfinished sitting in the middle of a workbench.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfinished' cuts PISTOL to PISTO; 'on' only joins it to the N.
explanation.definitionFit: An engine part: the sliding cylinder driven inside a bore by pressure.

clue.text: Poor handling of disturbing ageism across America

indicators.note: across means the shuffled letters span the America letters, holding them inside
disturbing means the letters of ageism are thrown into disorder

parts.note: US is the United States

explanation.surface: Mistreatment of older people through ageism throughout America.
explanation.walkthrough: 'disturbing' rearranges the fodder to MISAGE, which 'across' then spans the abbreviation for America.
explanation.definitionFit: Misuse or wrong treatment of something is poor handling of it.

clue.text: Dominant swan on cold island lake makes popular choice for artists

parts.note: the lead is the dominant or leading role
a pen is a female swan
C is the abbreviation for cold, as on taps

explanation.surface: A dominant swan on a cold lake island appeals to painters.
explanation.walkthrough: A PEN is a female swan, a crossword favourite.
explanation.definitionFit: Graphite drawing implements are a standard tool artists sketch with.

clue.text: Last bit of nearly decent beer

indicators.note: nearly means the decent word stops one letter short

parts.note: fine means decent or acceptable
ale is a type of beer

explanation.surface: The dregs of a fairly decent beer.
explanation.definitionFit: The closing part of a show or piece of music is its last bit.

clue.text: Infiltration of Coventry is militant

indicators.note: of means the answer is a part of the following words, sitting inside them

explanation.surface: Militants infiltrating Coventry politics.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer lies inside 'Coventry is militant'.
explanation.definitionFit: A political term for joining a party to subvert it from within, as Militant Tendency did.

clue.text: Two women consecutively having illness

parts.note: a mother, ma, is one woman
a lady is the second woman

explanation.surface: Two women in turn come down with an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A malady is a disease or ailment, a synonym for sickness.

clue.text: Arctic Russian discards clothing in warmer European region

indicators.note: discards clothing means the outer letters, the covering of the word, are stripped away

parts.note: a Siberian lives in the cold far north of Russia

explanation.surface: A Russian from the frozen north strips off on reaching sunny southern Europe.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula holding Spain and Portugal is far warmer than Siberia.

clue.text: Remain in boats heading west having dumped cargo

indicators.note: a boat that has dumped its cargo is empty in the middle, so the inner letters go
heading west in an across clue means reading from right to left, backwards

parts.note: yachts are boats

explanation.surface: Stay aboard while the boats sail west and jettison their freight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'heading west' turns YACHTS into STHCAY; 'having dumped cargo' removes its middle HC.
explanation.definitionFit: To stay is to remain in place, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Charge raving mad nun (the one pulled from the bog)

definitions.text: the one pulled from the bog

parts.note: a toll is a charge for using a road or bridge

indicators.note: raving means wildly disordered, so the letters of mad nun are rearranged

explanation.surface: A deranged nun gets charged, and someone is hauled out of a swamp.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is the Iron Age body found preserved in a Danish peat bog in 1950.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous Danish bog body was found by peat cutters and lifted out of the mire.

clue.text: Smarten up by wearing this oriental-sounding number

indicators.note: the oriental-sounding word is one that is said like the word for something from Thailand

parts.note: Thai means from Thailand in the East
a PIN is a personal identification number

explanation.surface: Dress smartly by wearing something with an Eastern-sounding number.
explanation.walkthrough: Only the first half is a homophone: THAI said aloud gives TIE, then PIN is spelt as it is.
explanation.definitionFit: A decorative pin holding a necktie in place is worn to look smart.

clue.text: Prayer from teetering treetop in Italy

indicators.note: teetering means unsteady, so the letters wobble into a new order

parts.note: I is the international vehicle code for Italy

explanation.surface: A prayer offered from a swaying treetop in Italy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prayer' means one who prays, not the request itself.
explanation.definitionFit: A petitioner is someone who makes a formal request, so one who prays in the old sense.

clue.text: 8 Down sailor involved in health drive needs meds regularly

indicators.note: involved in means the sailor letters are placed inside the health drive word

parts.note: a diet is a drive to improve health
AB is an able seaman

indicators.note: regularly takes every other letter of the word meds

explanation.surface: A sailor on a health kick needs his medicines at regular intervals.
explanation.walkthrough: 8 Down is MALADY, so the definition is an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A chronic disease of blood sugar regulation is an illness.

clue.text: Established arrival time to return car

indicators.note: to return means the arrival time letters go back the other way

parts.note: ETA is an estimated time of arrival

explanation.surface: A scheduled time to bring a hire car back.
explanation.walkthrough: In British English an estate is a station wagon.
explanation.definitionFit: A British estate car has a long body with a rear hatch, a kind of car.

clue.text: Tungsten in container solidifies, forming threads

indicators.note: in means the tungsten letter goes inside the container word

parts.note: a tin is a container
W is the chemical symbol for tungsten
jelly sets when it solidifies

explanation.surface: Tungsten set hard in a vessel to make fibres.
explanation.walkthrough: 'threads' is slang for clothes; twinsets are matching jumper and cardigan pairs.
explanation.definitionFit: Threads is slang for clothes, and these knitted matching pairs are garments.

clue.text: Warning for others with an encouragement towards crime?

definitions.meaning: a signal fire or light warning others of danger
read as ..., urging someone to become a convict

explanation.surface: A cautionary example that might also tempt others into wrongdoing.
explanation.walkthrough: Split as BE A CON, the answer urges someone to turn criminal; the question mark flags the pun.
explanation.definitionFit: A signal light or fire alerting people to danger serves as a warning.

clue.text: Anatomical part in manic bonk scene not initially spotted

indicators.note: manic means frenzied, so the letters are rearranged wildly
not initially spotted means the opening letter of scene is missing

explanation.surface: A body part glimpsed in a frantic sex scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'not initially spotted' drops the S of SCENE, leaving CENE; 'manic' shuffles BONK with CENE.
explanation.definitionFit: A vertebra of the neck is a bone, so a part of the anatomy.

clue.text: Professor emptied every lecture

indicators.note: emptied means the word professor loses all its inside letters

parts.note: each means every

explanation.surface: A professor cleared out every lecture hall.
explanation.definitionFit: To preach at someone is to lecture them moralistically; both are verbs.

clue.text: Seller of dope here in Berlin

parts.note: a dope is a fool or clot
hier is the German word for here

explanation.surface: Where to buy drugs here in Berlin.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dope' looks like drugs but is a fool, CLOT.
explanation.definitionFit: A clothier makes or sells cloth and garments, so is a kind of seller.

clue.text: In bed with loyalist party after Blair is defrocked

indicators.note: after places the party letters following the stripped name
defrocked means stripped of the outer covering, so the outside letters of Blair go

parts.note: the DUP is the Democratic Unionist Party of Northern Ireland, a loyalist party

explanation.surface: An ex-premier stripped of office, in league with a Northern Irish party.
explanation.walkthrough: The DUP propped up a UK government in 2017, so the surface is topical.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone confined to bed by illness is out of action, an idiom for being bedridden.

clue.text: Bones possibly genuine? Not a single Catholic suspects at first

indicators.note: not means the letter a is taken away from the genuine word

parts.note: real means genuine
I is the Roman numeral one, a single

indicators.note: at first takes the opening letter of each of Catholic and suspects

explanation.surface: A Catholic doubts whether saintly bones are authentic.
explanation.definitionFit: Saints' remains, often bones, are kept and venerated as relics; possibly flags an example.

clue.text: Staggered wine courses around the fish

indicators.note: courses around means the wine word flows round the fish word

parts.note: red is a wine
an eel is a fish

explanation.surface: A dinner where wine courses accompany the fish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'courses' looks like meal courses but is the verb flows.
explanation.definitionFit: To have reeled is to have lurched unsteadily, the same as staggered.

clue.text: Key exercise of youngster prior to climb

indicators.note: prior to places the youngster word before the climb word

parts.note: a minor is someone under age
to scale is to climb

explanation.surface: A child's crucial task before going up a mountain.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Key' is the musical key, not 'crucial'.
explanation.definitionFit: Practising scales in a minor key is a standard piano exercise.

clue.text: Coastal area across Britain has sound population growth

indicators.note: across means the bay word stretches over the Britain letter, holding it

parts.note: a bay is an inlet of the coast
a boom is a loud deep sound

explanation.surface: A seaside region in Britain enjoys a healthy rise in residents.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' looks like 'healthy' but is a noise.
explanation.definitionFit: A sudden surge in birth rate, notably after 1945, is a rise in population.

clue.text: See 24
Bright Liberal attends university with money

parts.note: a cent is a coin, money

explanation.surface: A clever Liberal goes to college with funding.
explanation.definitionFit: A literary adjective for shining or glowing, the same as luminous.

clue.text: Coat snagged in shoe when dancing for events

indicators.note: snagged in means the coat word is caught inside the shuffled letters
when dancing means the letters of shoe move about

parts.note: down is the soft feather coat of a bird

explanation.surface: A coat caught on a dancing shoe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coat' is a bird's soft feathers, not a garment; 'when dancing' gives HOES.
explanation.definitionFit: Barn-dance gatherings with square dancing are social events.
